home_description: Dinoscript is a free coding editor for kids. Write your first program with Pip the triceratops in your browser or in the offline desktop app.
home_title: Dinoscript · Learn to code with Pip
intro: Write your first program, make text games, and solve math puzzles with Pip the triceratops. Dinoscript is free and open source.
choose_package: Choose the package for your computer.
install_help_html: On Mac, open the disk image and drag Dinoscript to Applications. On Windows, extract the ZIP and open Dinoscript.exe. The Mac apps are ad-hoc signed. The Windows executable is unsigned.
linux_install_help: Run the command in the folder where you saved the package. Then open Dinoscript from the GNOME or KDE app menu. Dinoscript uses X11 or XWayland.
learn_intro_html: Follow the illustrated lessons from your first line of code to loops, functions, and playable games. Read along online, print the PDF, or press <kbd>F1</kbd> in the app to open the lessons offline.
